coverage.finding: The folio number '231b.' is at the top left, with the b superscript. The candidate reading matches the image.
Faint pencil 'n/ tt/', upper right, with a dot under n and dots under the second group. The second slash is long and heavier, perhaps retraced. 'Overstruck' is an overstatement and is adjusted.

The ink line '119 ff (no beg. or end, & old foliation often gone). Of same type as Rūpamālā of Vimala Sarasvatī, I.O. 612.' has an interlinear word above the line before 'Of', read 'work' but cursive and uncertain. The left-pointing arrow at about [3030,1320] has a line continuing across the gutter to '✓d' on fol. 232 at the same height (the d. 234(1) line).

The ticked entry 'C.391(1) Roga…nirṇaya (title uncertain), 30 ff.' has a caret below the line after 'ff.' and an interlinear word above it, read 'work' or perhaps 'unk.'. The line continues 'describing various diseases, 20 ff. preceded by, under'. A second line, 'describing various diseases', sits beneath, with no visible cancellation. The left-pointing arrow at right pairs with a right-pointing arrow on the facing strip.
'n.d.:31:12/14:Beng' is at right below the first line of b004. Grouping it with r004 is reasonable. Interpreting '31' as the line count is not secure and is adjusted.
Faint pencil 'ā/ ā/', with macrons visible.

'ff. 179. ends as Calc. Sc., II, 477, but beg. differs.' has no shelfmark. The left-pointing arrow at right reaches the gutter at about the height of fol. 232 '✓d. 146 (1) Lakṣahoma'. The following facing-page entry d. 135(2) also cites Calc. SC II, 477, so the target remains only probable.
A very faint '/?' at about [2930,4050] lies among reverse-side show-through (near a reversed 'd. 793(1)'-like trace). It may be on-side pencil or show-through; this remains unresolved.
